name: Falcon Ridge Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Blue. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: Routing, pars and card are right. Only two Blue tees are wrong (11, 18).

11: Black OK. Blue tee WRONG: the lidar pad is ~45 yds right of the line in trees beside houses. Move it onto the Black tee -> green line, 20 yds ahead of Black.
18: Black OK (OSM box). Blue tee WRONG: placed in the maintenance/parking lot east of the tee. Move it onto the Black tee -> green line, 28 yds ahead of Black (OSM box 1392245465).
